headline: Jayden Daniels to see specialists before Commanders form plan
summary: The Commanders have not established a timeline for star quarterback Jayden Daniels to return from a dislocated left elbow.

headline: Bears' Johnson: Williams week-to-week, but not ruled out for MNF
summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is considered "week-to-week" with a right hamstring injury he sustained in a 9-3 loss to the Vikings, coach Ben Johnson said Monday afternoon.

headline: Adam Schefter: Michael Penix Jr. will start for the Falcons vs. the Packers
summary: Adam Schefter: Michael Penix Jr. will start for the Falcons vs. the Packers

headline: Saints LT Kelvin Banks to have ankle surgery, out indefinitely
summary: Saints left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. is out indefinitely with a high ankle sprain and needs surgery, coach Kellen Moore said Monday.

headline: Lions lose DB Avonte Maddox for season; Dan Campbell defends DC
summary: The embattled Lions defense has lost defensive back Avonte Maddox for the season, while coach Dan Campbell is defending second-year defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard.

headline: Cody White making a name for himself as Raiders start 2-0
summary: Daniel Oyefusi breaks down how practice squad wide receiver Cody White made an impact with two touchdowns as the Raiders moved to 2-0.
